primary_user_goal: Understand Linear's value proposition for project management
copy_summary: Bold headline 'Linear is a purpose-built tool for planning and building products' with animated product demo. Emphasis on speed and modern design.
notes: Striking dark theme with purple accents. The animated product demo shows the app in action. 'Purpose-built' messaging differentiates from generic tools. Company logos provide social proof. Minimal navigation keeps focus on conversion.

primary_business_goal: Build confidence and desire for the product
copy_summary: Feature grid highlighting: Keyboard-first design, Cycles for planning, Roadmaps, GitHub/GitLab integration. Each with brief explanation.
notes: Feature cards are scannable with clear icons. The keyboard shortcuts emphasis signals power-user focus. Integration logos build confidence. Sticky CTA ensures conversion is always accessible.

primary_user_goal: Create workspace to start using Linear
primary_business_goal: Complete account setup with workspace context
copy_summary: Clean form asking for workspace name and URL. Explanation that workspace is team's home. Option to join existing workspace.
notes: Minimal form with just essential fields. URL auto-generates from workspace name. Clean, fast onboarding matches product philosophy. No unnecessary questions.

primary_business_goal: Increase user count and stickiness through team adoption
copy_summary: Email input for team invites with clear explanation. Option to skip and invite later.
notes: Skip option respects users who want to explore solo first. Multi-email input is efficient. Team size affects pricing tier, so this is also qualification.

primary_user_goal: See what needs attention and manage work
primary_business_goal: Drive daily engagement and task completion
copy_summary: Three-column layout: sidebar navigation, issue list, issue detail. Inbox shows notifications and assigned items. Keyboard shortcuts visible.
notes: Information-dense but well-organized. The three-column layout is powerful but takes learning. Keyboard shortcut hints encourage power usage. Dark theme reduces eye strain for long sessions.

primary_user_goal: Quickly navigate or take action without mouse
primary_business_goal: Enable power-user efficiency and differentiate from competitors
copy_summary: Command palette (Cmd+K) showing recent actions, navigation options, and search. Fuzzy matching for fast finding.
notes: The command palette is Linear's signature feature. Everything is accessible via keyboard. Recent items shown first. Actions grouped logically. This is what makes Linear feel 'fast'.

primary_business_goal: Capture work items with appropriate metadata
copy_summary: Issue creation modal with title, description, assignee, priority, labels, project, cycle. Keyboard shortcuts for each field.
notes: Can create issue with just title - everything else optional. Keyboard shortcuts for every field (P for priority, etc.). Smart defaults based on context. Markdown support in description.

primary_business_goal: Enable effective issue tracking and collaboration
copy_summary: Issue detail with description, activity feed, sub-issues, relations. Properties panel on right. Full editing capability inline.
notes: Dense information display for power users. Activity feed shows full history. Relations and sub-issues support complex work breakdown. Everything editable inline.

primary_user_goal: See project timeline and plan work
primary_business_goal: Enable strategic planning and stakeholder communication
copy_summary: Gantt-style timeline showing projects and milestones. Drag to adjust dates. Color coding by team or status.
notes: Powerful visualization for planning. Draggable timeline items. Zoom levels for different time horizons. This view is particularly useful for leadership and stakeholder communication.
